The '''hall d'main''' was a creature discovered by [[Beldorion]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] second [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] chief. The excretions of this creature were discovered to have a profound effect on the [[glet-mite]]s teleological system, causing unusual growth.
